data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Android root detection and iOS jailbreak detection.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to check whether an Android device is rooted or has developer mode enabled, and whether an iOS device is jailbroken. Uses native libraries like RootBeer and DTTJailbreakDetection underneath.
use_when: You need to detect rooted Android devices or jailbroken iOS devices for security-sensitive apps.
You want to check if developer options are enabled on Android.
avoid_when: You require foolproof security, as these checks are best-effort and can be bypassed by hiding tools.
Your app targets platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports Swift Package Manager alongside CocoaPods on iOS.
Migrated to built-in Kotlin for Android.
weaknesses: Can produce false negatives due to root/jailbreak hiding tools, or false positives on custom ROMs.
Requires handling PlatformException for unsupported states.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSdk 24 or later, iOS 13.0 or later, Flutter 3.44.0 or later, and Dart 3.12.0 or later.
